title: Frost project manifest
description: A frost.json sitting beside the file named on the command line. It answers one question a relative import cannot, which is where a library this project depends on lives.

name.description: What the project calls itself. Not used for resolution. It is here so a diagnostic can name the project rather than a directory.

paths.description: Directories to search for an import, relative to this manifest. Searched after the importing file's own directory and any -L path.

items.description: A directory, relative to this manifest
